milestones.vision: 把湿地百分比、分类准确度/分类分歧、时间趋势正确性三条分析线统一成同一套论文级证据合同，先在 hydro-diverse canonical subset 上闭合，再扩展到十个大区，为后续热点成因解释与 fraction-first 融合提供稳定输入。
success_criteria: The percentage, classification, and trend lines share one explicit contract for regions, grids, hotspot objects, summaries, and paper-facing artifact semantics.
A hydro-diverse canonical subset proves the full three-line pipeline end-to-end before scale-out.
The same contract scales to all ten target regions without redefining schemas or hotspot identity.
Wide runs remain replayable through split/cache/merge patterns rather than one-shot fragile execution.
At least one paper-ready evidence pack exists and is traceable back to reproducible artifacts.

key_risks.risk: Existing modules already produce useful outputs, but their proof levels and output contracts are uneven.
key_risks.whyItMatters: M002 can drift into glue code and manual reconciliation unless it first standardizes what each line emits and how those outputs are trusted.

key_risks.risk: The current canonical Phase 4 route is known but wide execution still has HPC-only proof gaps.
key_risks.whyItMatters: If M002 over-trusts broad reruns too early, the milestone can fail operationally before the evidence contract is even stable.

key_risks.risk: Hotspots are currently line-specific concepts rather than one project-level analysis object.
key_risks.whyItMatters: M003 explanation and M004 fusion will fragment immediately if M002 does not establish one shared hotspot ledger.

key_risks.risk: Engineering outputs may remain disconnected from thesis writing needs.
key_risks.whyItMatters: If M002 stops at caches and scripts, later milestones will need to rebuild figure/table semantics instead of consuming stable evidence packs.

proof_strategy.riskOrUnknown: Can the three evidence lines be forced onto one shared contract without losing their scientific meaning?
proof_strategy.whatWillBeProven: A stable shared contract exists and can carry percentage, trend, and classification hotspots into one ledger.

proof_strategy.riskOrUnknown: Will the subset-first strategy still scale to the full ten-region thesis scope?
proof_strategy.whatWillBeProven: The same artifact contract and execution discipline can scale from the canonical subset to all ten regions.

proof_strategy.riskOrUnknown: Will the unified outputs actually support paper writing instead of only engineering inspection?
proof_strategy.whatWillBeProven: A traceable paper-ready figure/table/summary pack exists and is derived from the shared contract artifacts.

proof_strategy.riskOrUnknown: Can operational reruns remain trustworthy under the current HPC proof boundaries?
proof_strategy.whatWillBeProven: The key wide-scope outputs are generated through replayable split/cache/merge patterns with visible proof targets and artifact traces.

milestones.verification_contract: Run targeted contract-level verification over the comparison, hotspot, trend, and plotting modules plus artifact/schema checks. Verify that required files, manifests, and summaries exist with substantive content and stable field structure rather than only passing isolated unit tests.
milestones.verification_integration: Exercise the same contract across percentage, trend, and classification outputs on the canonical subset, then re-check that the ten-region scale-out still feeds the same hotspot ledger and paper-facing artifact layer.
milestones.verification_operational: Verify that wide-scope execution paths remain replayable under HPC-oriented split/cache/merge discipline, with visible manifests, cache states, and proof-target artifacts rather than one-off successful runs.
milestones.verification_uat: Human review checks that the paper-facing packs read like thesis evidence rather than engineering debug output, and that the canonical subset plus ten-region packs match the intended narrative order.
definition_of_done: All M002 slices are complete and their outputs are still aligned to one shared contract.
The three evidence lines are actually wired together through a shared hotspot ledger rather than only coexisting in parallel.
The canonical subset and ten-region outputs are both reproducible through the intended execution path.
Paper-ready figures/tables/summaries exist and trace back cleanly to reproducible artifacts.
M003 and M004 can consume M002 outputs without redefining the project’s core evidence objects.
milestones.requirement_coverage: Covers R101-R107 and R113. Establishes the stable inputs later needed for R108-R112, but does not itself complete hotspot-cause explanation or fusion evaluation.

slices.title: Canonical subset contract + wetland-percentage backbone
slices.demo: After this: 一组 hydro-diverse canonical regions 能稳定产出共享 schema 的 `0.25°` 湿地百分比 surfaces、regional summaries、hotspot manifests，作为后三条线共用的第一层证据。
slices.goal: 先定义并证明 percentage line 的共享 region/grid/output contract，同时把 canonical subset 变成后续所有切片共用的 proof surface。
slices.success_criteria:
- 明确一套 shared region / grid / hotspot / summary contract，并写成可复用的工程对象或明确 schema。
- canonical subset 上的 wetland-percentage line 能从输入走到 outputs，不依赖手工拼装。
- 产物至少包含 comparison-ready surface、regional summary、hotspot manifest、paper-facing figure/table primitives。
- 这些产物能被后续 trend/class 切片直接消费，而不是重定义。
slices.proof_level: Contract proof on a hydro-diverse canonical subset with replayable scripts, artifacts, and schema checks.
slices.integration_closure: Percentage outputs establish the contract and artifact layout that downstream trend/class slices must consume unchanged.
slices.observability_impact: Emit explicit contract metadata, canonical-subset artifact inventories, and per-run summaries so later slices can validate schema stability instead of re-deriving it.

slices.title: Trend-correctness backbone on the shared contract
slices.demo: After this: 同一批 canonical regions 能产出统一 schema 的 trend metrics、trend hotspot manifests、以及区域级 trend summaries，而不是零散 probe 输出。
slices.goal: 把 trend line 绑定到 S01 定义的 shared contract 上，形成可直接并排比较的 trend evidence line。
slices.success_criteria:
- trend line 的输入、aggregation window、output schema 与 S01 合同对齐。
- canonical subset 上能产出趋势斜率、显著性、agreement/disputed 类结果与 hotspot manifests。
- regional summary 字段与 S01 保持兼容，便于 cross-line 对齐。
- 结果不再依赖 ad hoc probe-only 形式才能解释。
slices.proof_level: Subset integration proof: trend modules produce contract-aligned outputs on the same canonical subset as S01.
slices.integration_closure: Trend outputs can be joined with S01 percentage outputs by region, metric family, hotspot identity, and summary schema.
slices.observability_impact: Write explicit trend-run manifests, overlap-window metadata, and summary artifacts so trend proof level is visible and reviewable.

slices.title: Classification-disagreement backbone on the shared contract
slices.demo: After this: `G2017 / GLWD / GWD30` 能在 `500m` / unified-8-class 口径下产出 contract-aligned entropy / majority / agreement products 与 classification hotspot manifests。
slices.goal: 把现有 classification disagreement surfaces 收束到统一 hotspot / summary / paper-artifact contract 上。
slices.success_criteria:
- `G2017 / GLWD / GWD30` 的 unified-8-class outputs 与 shared hotspot/schema 合同对齐。
- canonical subset 上能产出 entropy、majority/agreement、hotspot manifests、regional summaries。
- classification outputs 和 S01/S02 一样能直接进入共享 hotspot ledger。
- 结果保留足够分类语义，供后续 M003 的 land-cover/机制解释使用。
slices.proof_level: Subset contract proof on existing 500m classification disagreement surfaces and their regionalized derivatives.
slices.integration_closure: Classification outputs align to the same hotspot and summary contracts used by percentage and trend lines.
slices.observability_impact: Emit classification artifact manifests and class-summary metadata so later land-cover interpretation can trace exactly which outputs were used.

slices.title: Unified hotspot ledger and cross-line evidence surfaces
slices.demo: After this: 三条主线的热点都能落到同一种 analysis object，上层可以按 region / metric family / hotspot_id 统一引用、排序、和交叉比较。
slices.goal: 把 percentage / trend / classification 三条线的 outputs 汇总成一个共享 hotspot ledger 与 cross-line evidence surface。
slices.success_criteria:
- 三条主线的热点都能进入同一种 shared ledger，不再各自维护不同对象。
- ledger 至少包含 metric family、region、bbox、score、supporting artifact paths 等共用字段。
- 可以按 region 或 hotspot_id 做 cross-line 汇总与对照。
- 该层成为 M003 成因解释与 M004 融合评估的稳定输入，而不是重新抽样。
slices.proof_level: Cross-line integration proof: shared hotspot objects exist and can reference all three evidence families together.
slices.integration_closure: This slice is the bridge from per-line analysis to project-level synthesis; M003 and M004 consume this ledger rather than raw disconnected outputs.
slices.observability_impact: Write one shared hotspot ledger plus cross-line trace artifacts so downstream milestones can inspect evidence provenance without re-running earlier slices.

slices.title: Ten-region scale-out with reproducible HPC-safe execution
slices.demo: After this: 从 canonical subset 扩到十个大区时，三条主线都能沿同一合同输出结果，并且关键宽范围运行仍然是 split/cache/merge 可复跑的。
slices.goal: 把 shared contract 从 canonical subset 扩展到十个大区，同时保持 HPC-safe execution discipline。
slices.success_criteria:
- 十个大区都能沿 S01-S04 定义的合同产出 percentage / trend / classification 主结果。
- 关键宽范围执行保持 year-split / cache / merge / manifest discipline，而不是 one-shot fragile runs。
- 宽范围输出的 artifact layout 与 canonical subset 保持一致。
- scale-out 后没有引入新的 ad hoc schema 分叉。
slices.proof_level: Operational scale proof across all ten regions with replayable HPC-oriented execution patterns.
slices.integration_closure: Wide-region outputs remain contract-compatible with subset outputs and therefore feed the same unified hotspot ledger and paper pack.
slices.observability_impact: Expose scale-out logs, cache states, manifests, and proof-target artifacts so ten-region runs remain auditable and resumable.

slices.title: Paper-ready evidence pack and milestone integration proof
slices.demo: After this: 至少一套可直接支撑论文结构的 figure/table/summary pack 已形成，且三条主线在十区上的核心产物都经过重新集成验证。
slices.goal: 把 M002 的工程输出整理成论文主线可直接消费的 evidence pack，并完成 milestone 级集成证明。
slices.success_criteria:
- 至少形成一套 paper-ready figures/tables/summaries，能对应 thesis 主线中的三条证据线。
- pack 的每项内容都能追溯到 shared contract artifacts，而不是人工复制。
- 十区 scale-out 后的主要 outputs 被重新做 milestone-level integration verification。
- M003/M004 可以把 M002 outputs 当稳定输入，而不是再定义新基础产物。
slices.proof_level: Milestone integration proof: subset-first and ten-region outputs are assembled into thesis-ready evidence packs with traceable provenance.
slices.integration_closure: This slice closes M002 by proving the unified contract survives full assembly into paper-facing artifacts.
slices.observability_impact: Generate a paper-facing artifact index, traceable figure/table manifests, and milestone-level verification notes.
